3.  Recommendation to: 1. Re­open Public Hearing and allow the public and developer to provide
  testimony regarding PLNG2021­002, An Amendment to the General Plan Land Use Element Map,
  from General Commercial to High Density Residential (R­4) for property located at 12345 Carson
  Street, Assessor Parcel Number (APN) 7066­017­127; Initial Study/Mitigated Negative
  Declaration (MND) and Mitigation Monitoring Program (MMP) under the California Environmental
  Quality Act; PLNG2021­0025 Rezoning a property from C­4 (General Commercial) to R­4, and
  Site Plan and Architectural Design of a new 13­unit apartment complex.
  2. Direct Staff to prepare resolutions approving PLNG2021­0026, MND/MMP, PLNG2021­0025;
  and Site Plan and Architectural Design for a new 13­unit apartment complex located at 12345
  Carson Street, APN: 7066­017­127.

  0025; and Site Plan and Architectural Design for a new 13­unit apartment complex located at
  12345 Carson Street, APN: 7066­017­127.
  4. Direct Staff to request additional information from developer.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.
